notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
